initialization: All arms reuse the same 13 locked Stage05 refined_joint warm-start artifacts, including the seed2024 catalog tokenizer and matching pretrained DiffGRM checkpoint. Only subsequent training rand_seed is 2025 or 2026. Pairwise base parameters, SID and RNG must match; cross-seed base hashes are reported rather than assumed equal. This is not independent end-to-end tokenizer pretraining.
training: 45 logical epochs: 5 recommender warmup epochs, then 10 cycles of 1 tokenizer phase and 3 recommender epochs; 35 recommender epochs and 60 accumulated tokenizer optimizer updates. Set patience from the frozen recipe's 5 to 0 so all four arms receive the same training quantity.
selection: Preserve initial validation and evaluation every 5 recommender epochs, validation beam32 and weighted_score checkpoint selection. Evaluate each selected checkpoint separately on validation beam32 and beam256. No test-set evaluation in this campaign.
